text: When the government is more concerned about the blue passport, how will the green passport rise, Mazhar Abbas@MazharAbbasGEO
translated_text: 当政府更关心蓝色护照时，绿色护照将如何崛起，Mazhar Abbas@MazharAbbasGEO

text: Most of the problems facing Pakistan can be solved within the constitution. If it is implemented, the issues can be resolved, such as empowering local institutions to such an extent that they can address public problems, Mazhar Abbas@MazharAbbasGEO
translated_text: 巴基斯坦面临的大多数问题都可以在宪法范围内解决。如果实施，问题就可以得到解决，例如赋予地方机构足够的权力，使其能够解决公共问题，Mazhar Abbas@MazharAbbasGEO

text: The primary reason for the decline in the ranking of the Pakistani passport is the reduction in visa-free access by various countries; it has no direct connection to illegal smuggling, FakhreDrani@FrehmanD
translated_text: 巴基斯坦护照排名下降的主要原因是各国免签入境的减少；它与非法走私没有直接联系，FakhreDrani@FrehmanD

text: Merely creating small administrative units will not bring about the required change in Pakistan's system. If the system is to be made effective, both local government institutions and the bureaucracy will need to be strengthened, Fakhre Durrani@FrehmanD
translated_text: 仅仅创建小型行政单位不会给巴基斯坦的制度带来所需的改变。如果要使该系统有效，地方政府机构和官僚机构都需要得到加强，Fakhre Durrani@FrehmanD

text: There has been no reduction in illegal smuggling from Pakistan; it has only become more expensive than before, Izzaz Syed@AzazSyed
translated_text: 来自巴基斯坦的非法走私活动并未减少；它只是变得比以前更贵，Izzaz Syed@AzazSyed

text: Instead of creating new provinces, an effective local government system is a far better path, because only this can bring real change down to the grassroots level. Therefore, it is essential to restore and strengthen the local government system, Azaz Syed@AzazSyed
translated_text: 与其建立新的省份，建立有效的地方政府体系是一条更好的道路，因为只有这样才能给基层带来真正的改变。因此，恢复和加强地方政府体系至关重要，Azaz Syed@AzazSyed
